name: Equinix
description: Equinix runs neutral data centers (IBX) where companies rent space and power and, unlike an ordinary landlord, it sells the connections between those tenants. In 2025, 94 percent of revenue was recurring and billed monthly: $6,475M colocation (racks, cages, power) and $1,655M interconnection (cross-connects and exchange ports linking customers, clouds and networks inside the same building), plus other recurring services. The interconnection ecosystem is the moat: a customer wants to sit where its cloud, bank and network provider already are. A separate xScale line builds large campuses for hyperscalers with joint venture partners, and the joint ventures pay Equinix one-time fees. The 50 largest customers are about 36 percent of recurring revenue. It is a REIT by tax status but sells services more like a network company.
